File contract: Return solution.rs with the public function at module scope.
Required API: pub fn version_selection(input: &str) -> Option<String>
Behavior: Parse ceiling;version,version. Ceiling and versions are canonical major.minor.patch triples with each component in 0..1000000; at least one version is required and duplicates are invalid. Return the greatest version not above the ceiling using numeric component order, or the empty string when none qualifies.
Visible example: 2.1.0;1.9.9,2.1.1,2.0.5 returns 2.0.5.
